mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT evaluatee_id) FROM evaluator_mappings_51 WHERE period_id = #{periodId} AND is_deleted = 'n'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM final_grades_51 WHERE period_id = #{periodId} AND is_deleted = 'n'

SELECT final_grade_code as gradeCode, COUNT(*) as count FROM final_grades_51 WHERE period_id = #{periodId} AND is_deleted = 'n' AND final_grade_code IS NOT NULL AND final_grade_code != '-' GROUP BY final_grade_code ORDER BY final_grade_code ASC

SELECT d.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CAST(fg.total_score AS FLOAT)), 2), 0) as avgScore FROM departments_51 d LEFT JOIN employees_51 e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id LEFT JOIN final_grades_51 fg ON e.emp_id = fg.emp_id AND fg.period_id = #{periodId} AND fg.is_deleted = 'n' WHERE d.is_deleted = 'n' GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name ORDER BY avgScore DESC, d.dept_name ASC

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) e.name as evaluateeName, d.dept_name as deptName, fg.final_grade_code as grade, ISNULL(fg.updated_at, fg.created_at) as finalizedAt FROM final_grades_51 fg JOIN employees_51 e ON fg.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN departments_51 d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE fg.period_id = #{periodId} AND fg.is_deleted = 'n' ORDER BY ISNULL(fg.updated_at, fg.created_at) DESC

WITH TargetElements_51 AS ( SELECT ee.period_id, ee.dept_id, COUNT(*) as total_required FROM evaluation_elements_51 ee WHERE ee.period_id = #{periodId} AND ee.is_deleted = 'n' AND ee.element_type_code != 'MULTI_DIMENSIONAL' GROUP BY ee.period_id, ee.dept_id ), EmployeeRequired_51 AS ( SELECT emp.emp_id, COALESCE(te_dept.total_required, te_common.total_required, 0) as required_count FROM employees_51 emp LEFT JOIN TargetElements_51 te_dept ON te_dept.dept_id = emp.dept_id LEFT JOIN TargetElements_51 te_common ON te_common.dept_id IS NULL WHERE emp.emp_id = #{empId} ) SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(ev.eval_id) = 0 THEN 'NOT_STARTED' WHEN COUNT(ev.eval_id) < MAX(er.required_count) THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END FROM evaluator_mappings_51 m JOIN EmployeeRequired_51 er ON m.evaluatee_id = er.emp_id LEFT JOIN evaluations_51 ev ON m.mapping_id = ev.mapping_id AND ev.is_deleted = 'n' WHERE m.period_id = #{periodId} AND m.evaluatee_id = #{empId} AND m.evaluator_id = #{empId} AND m.relation_type_code = 'SELF' AND m.is_deleted = 'n' GROUP BY m.mapping_id

WITH ElementCounts_51 AS ( SELECT dept_id, COUNT(*) as req_count FROM evaluation_elements_51 WHERE period_id = #{periodId} AND is_deleted = 'n' AND element_type_code = 'MULTI_DIMENSIONAL' GROUP BY dept_id ), MappingStats_51 AS ( SELECT m.mapping_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluations_51 e JOIN evaluation_elements_51 ee ON e.element_id = ee.element_id WHERE e.mapping_id = m.mapping_id AND e.is_deleted = 'n' AND ee.element_type_code = 'MULTI_DIMENSIONAL') as actual_count, COALESCE(ec_dept.req_count, ec_common.req_count, 0) as required_count FROM evaluator_mappings_51 m JOIN employees_51 emp ON m.evaluatee_id = emp.emp_id LEFT JOIN ElementCounts_51 ec_dept ON ec_dept.dept_id = emp.dept_id LEFT JOIN ElementCounts_51 ec_common ON ec_common.dept_id IS NULL WHERE m.period_id = #{periodId} AND m.evaluator_id = #{empId} AND m.relation_type_code != 'SELF' AND m.is_deleted = 'n' ) SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN actual_count >= required_count AND required_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as completedCount FROM MappingStats_51

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) ep.period_name as periodName, fg.final_grade_code as grade FROM final_grades_51 fg JOIN evaluation_periods_51 ep ON fg.period_id = ep.period_id WHERE fg.emp_id = #{empId} AND fg.is_deleted = 'n' AND ep.status_code IN ('COMPLETED', 'CLOSED') ORDER BY ep.period_year DESC, ep.period_id DESC
